 who you are 
To make a good start as a warehouse employee at JYSK, we require the following: - You are fluent in English. - You have a valid reach truck or forklift certification. - You have similar logistics experience. - You are able to perform various physical activities, including lifting weights up to 25 kg. - You have your own transportation (car, scooter of bike). 
 what will you do 
As a warehouse employee, you're a vital link in the JYSK distribution center! Operating the reach truck or forklift, you ensure a streamlined and efficient flow of goods. Thanks to you, goods are always in the right location and stores remain fully stocked. Together with your team, you'll ensure the best quality. - Transporting goods from the handover area to picking locations using a reach truck or forklift. - Retrieving goods from storage locations and moving them to the handover area. - Unloading incoming trucks and containers.
